narrative.summary: The Ibero-American community's recorded AI text is the Madrid Declaration of the Ibero-American Ministerial Meeting on Digital Transformation and Artificial Intelligence, adopted on 3 November 2026 ahead of the XXX Ibero-American Summit. Ministers commit to people-centred, safe and trustworthy AI with human oversight in decisions with significant effects on people, approve an Ibero-American AI Alliance for adoption by the Summit, and adopt non-binding reference frameworks on data protection and on digital identification and interoperability. Argentina and Paraguay dissociated themselves from the declaration.

instruments.current_status: Adopted in Madrid on 3 November 2026, in preparation for the XXX Ibero-American Summit; Argentina and Paraguay dissociated themselves from the declaration. The Summit's Declaration of Madrid (5 November 2026, paragraph 10) adopted the creation of the Ibero-American AI Alliance under SEGIB coordination, open to voluntary accession; Argentina and Paraguay dissociated from that paragraph. Published on the official site of the host government (Spain, Ministry for Digital Transformation); no copy on the SEGIB site was found.
instruments.scope: Ibero-American countries that did not dissociate from the declaration.
instruments.summary: Ministerial declaration of Ibero-American countries committing to people-centred, safe and trustworthy AI with data protection, cybersecurity, transparency, proportionate traceability and human oversight where AI is used in decisions with significant effects on people, and to age-appropriate, bias-free digital environments. It approves an Ibero-American AI Alliance (a federated data and interoperability space, AI models in Spanish, Portuguese and other languages, and high-performance computing cooperation) for adoption by the XXX Ibero-American Summit, and adopts non-binding Ibero-American reference frameworks on data protection and on digital identification and interoperability in digital government services.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Ministerial commitments on AI across the Ibero-American community, including a proposed Ibero-American AI Alliance.

leads.title: Declaración de Madrid, XXX Cumbre Iberoamericana de Jefas y Jefes de Estado y de Gobierno (5 November 2026)
leads.note: General summit declaration; paragraph 10 adopts the creation of the Ibero-American AI Alliance under SEGIB coordination, voluntary accession, in line with the Ibero-American Charter of Principles and Rights in Digital Environments. Argentina and Paraguay dissociate from paragraph 10. AI is one paragraph of 20 (scope test); see the ministerial declaration record.

leads.title: Alianza Iberoamericana de Inteligencia Artificial (proposal document)
leads.note: 18-page proposal by Spain as Pro Tempore Secretariat (published with the 3 November 2026 ministerial documents): three components (federated data and interoperability space, language models in Ibero-American languages, compute cooperation), governance by an Intergovernmental Council with SEGIB as executive secretariat, indicative annual contributions. Written as a proposal ('se propone') with no adoption date printed; the Summit adopted the Alliance's creation on 5 November 2026. Record if an adopted founding text is published. Decision 2026-11-17 (Faisal): stays a lead; the Summit adopted the Alliance's creation, not this text (adoption already noted on the ministerial declaration record). Record once an adopted founding text (e.g. a charter or first Council decision) is published by SEGIB.
